name: ST-GA
prompt: The side of a white fibreglass boat hull filling most of the frame. Black vinyl registration lettering reading exactly "GA 1234 AB" is applied three inches tall on the forward half, in plain upright block capitals, with a small validation decal aft of it. In the background, red clay at the edge of a concrete ramp with loblolly pines behind, slightly out of focus. The boat is floating upright in the water alongside a dock, seen from the dock. It is NOT overturned, capsized, hauled out or upside down. The waterline is visible along the bottom of the hull. CAMERA: standing directly beside the boat, lens perpendicular to the hull side, at the same height as the lettering - a flat, square-on view with no foreshortening and no looking along the hull. The lettering therefore sits flat to the camera, perfectly upright, with every vertical stroke parallel to the edge of the photograph. Casual smartphone snapshot taken by the boat owner, not a professional photograph. Flat overcast daylight, no golden hour. Visible sensor noise, water spots and faint scuffs on the hull. Natural muted colour, no HDR, no glow. Do not render: human faces, brand logos, place names, signage, italic or slanted or sheared lettering, golden-hour light, oversaturated colour, HDR halos, studio lighting, watermark.
